Package com.nexuslink.protocol.azure

Class AzureConnectionString

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.azure.AzureConnectionString
public final class AzureConnectionString extends Object
Pure, dependency-free parser for an Azure Storage connection string. Azure connection strings are a sequence of Key=Value; pairs with case-insensitive keys, e.g. 
DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName=acc;AccountKey=abc123==;EndpointSuffix=core.windows.net

This does no network I/O and pulls in no SDK; it just parses the string and exposes the recognised fields plus the derived service endpoints. It mirrors the well-known shape used by the Azure Storage SDK, including the UseDevelopmentStorage=true shortcut for the local Azurite emulator.
